headline: Approved tax incentives for manufacturing at 72-86 Rossotto Drive, a Walkable Sidewalks project, tax refunds, and three contracts.
summary: Two members of the public spoke during public input. The president referred Solid Waste and Recycling Commission materials to the Public Works Committee. The Firefighters' contract will go to committee before it returns for final action.
decisions: Referred Solid Waste and Recycling Commission agenda and minutes to the Public Works Committee.
Approved refund of $4,417.19 in property and motor vehicle taxes collected prior to 7/1/2025, unanimously as part of the consent calendar.
Approved refund of $107,100,20 in property tax collected between 7/1/25 and 6/30/26, unanimously as part of the consent calendar.
Approved refund of $21,352.41 in motor vehicle taxes collected between 7/1/2025 and 6/30/2026, unanimously as part of the consent calendar.
Approved agreement for real property tax incentives for manufacturing at 72-86 Rossotto Drive, unanimously as part of the consent calendar.
Approved expanded network access service agreement with the State of Connecticut and Connecticut Education Network, unanimously as part of the consent calendar.
Approved First Supplemental Project Authorization Letter with the State Department of Transportation for the Walkable Sidewalks construction project, unanimously.
Approved additional municipal audit services with Marcum LLP d/b/a CBIZ CPAs, 13-0.
Approved additional services consulting agreement with Clifton Larson Allen LLP, 13-0.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL 
REGULAR MEETING 
 
AUGUST 17, 2026 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Present - Katie Kiely, President 
Present - Sean Cardwell, Pro Tem 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Maj Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Min Leader 
Present - Tasha Hunt, Majority Whip 
Present - Tom Figlar, Minority Whip 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Doug Foley 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Present - Rhonda Caldwell 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Present - Ted Stevens 
Present - Tameeka Parks  
1. Meeting Convenes 
 
Call of the Meeting and Taking of the Roll 
The Legislative Council Regular Meeting, August 17, 2026 was called to order at 7:04pm with 
the members noted above in attendance. 
 
Leadership Update 
President Kiely reported that Leadership had received the Firefighters' contract from Attorney 
Grello. She noted that the contract would first be reviewed by committee and, if approved, 
would be brought before the Legislative Council for final consideration at a subsequent regular 
meeting. 
 
News and Announcements and Celebrations 
President Kiely mentioned the recent Primary election and noted that she would get the totals 
of how many people participated and where Hamden stacked up within the state for the next 
meeting once all the totals are in from the registrar’s office and Town Clerk. 
 
2. Reports of Departments, Boards, Commissions, and Council Liaisons 
 
President Kiely acknowledged receipt of the Solid Waste and Recycling Commission's agenda 
and minutes and thanked the Commission for keeping the Council informed of its activities. She 
referred the materials to the Public Works Committee for review. 
 
She announced that the School Building Committee would hold its organizational meeting in 
late September to establish its meeting schedule. She also noted that the Hamden Public 
Schools calendar had been received and that the first day of school for students would be 
August 31. 
 
And she reported that the Board of Education had submitted its agenda and had recently held a 
workshop to review its goals, priorities, and strategic initiatives. She noted that the Board was 
working with Partners in Educational Leadership to update its strategic plan and ensure it
aligns with the Board's current goals and objectives. She stated that a final draft was 
anticipated for consideration at the Board's next meeting. 
 
3. Public Input 
Public Input was opened at 7:12pm.  Two members of the public spoke, and Public Input was 
closed at 7:15pm. 
  
4. CONSENT CALENDAR 
President Kiely pulled item 4.4 from the Consent Calendar to be voted on separately.  She 
then called for a motion to approve the Consent Calendar (Items 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.5, 4.6).  
Motion: Gallagher 
Second: Figlar   
  4.1. Refund of Property and Motor Vehicle Taxes collected prior to 7/1/2025. 
$4,417.19 
  
  4.2. Refund of Property Tax collected between 7/1/25 and 6/30/26  
$107,100,20 
  
  4.3. Refund of Motor Vehicle Taxes collected between 7/1/2025 and 6/30/2026 
$21,352.41 
  
  4.5. Order Approving and Authorizing the Mayor to Sign an Agreement for Real Property 
Tax Incentives for Manufacturing Use - 72-86 Rossotto Drive 
  
  4.6. Order to Approve Expanded Network Access Service Agreement Between the State 
of Connecticut, Connecticut Education Network and the Town of Hamden 
 
The Vote to approve items on the Consent Calendar - (Items 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.5, 4.6) 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Consent Calendar items passed 
unanimously. 
********** 
  
4.4. Order Approving First Supplemental Project Authorization Letter with the State of 
Connecticut Department of Transportation Walkable Sidewalks Construction Project No. 
61-153, Federal Project No. (PEDS (253) 
 
Motion to open item 4.4: Figlar 
Second: Gallagher   
 
After brief comments from Chief of Staff Peterson, President Kiely called for the vote. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item 4 passed unanimously.  
 
5. REGULAR AGENDA DELIBERATION AND ACTION   
  1. Order Authorizing Additional Municipal Audit Services with Marcum LLP d/b/a CBIZ 
CPAs for municipal audit related services
Motion to open item 5.1: Gallagher 
Second: Figlar 
With no questions/comments, President Kiely called for the vote. 
Vote: 13 in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item 5.1 passed unanimously. 
  
  2. Order Authorizing Additional Services Consulting Agreement with Clifton Larson Allen 
LLP 
 
Motion to open item 5.2: Figlar 
Second: Hunt 
With no questions/comments, President Kiely called for the vote. 
Vote: 13 in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  Item 5.2 passed unanimously. 
  
6. RECESS FOR STANDING COMMITTEE MEETINGS 
President Kiely recessed the Legislative Council meeting in order for the Committees to 
convene. She noted that this evening, the Administration and Settlement and Public 
Works Committees will meet.  Time of recess: 7:33pm. 
  
7. Resumption of Regular Council Meeting  
President Kiely called for a motion to accept the reports from the Committees: 
Motion: Cardwell 
Second: Anthony. 
   
ADJOURNMENT 
Motion to adjourn: Anthony 
President Kiely adjourned the meeting at approximately 9:20pm.
